вздумать.gloss: to take it into one's head; (neg.) don't even think about it

meanings.en: не вздумай! = don't even think about it!, don't you dare!
meanings.note: Used with infinitive. Prefix 'вз-' ('up') marks upward or sudden onset of action (stem 'думать'). Used as a perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to take it into one's head; (neg.) don't even think about it', paired with 'вздумывать'.

examples.trans: Don't even think about it, son. There always was.
Don't even think about going there!

examples.text: Не вздумай, сынок. Всегда были. Сейчас найдём.
examples.trans: Don't even think about it, son. There always was. We'll find some now.
